topic: What frequency planning challenges arise when coordinating multiple ground stations with overlapping satellite visibility windows?
consensus_response: Coordinating multiple ground stations with overlapping satellite visibility windows poses significant frequency planning challenges due to interference and spectral efficiency concerns. Techniques like beamforming, adaptive modulation, and cognitive radio enhance spatial selectivity and reduce interference, but introduce complexity in resource management and system design.
reference_context: SatCom systems face challenges in frequency reuse, interference mitigation, and spectral efficiency due to overlapping satellite visibility windows and shared spectrum with terrestrial networks.
